answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with bonded passports. First, it locks 500 POA for 30 days as a bond. Second, it completes 10 verified jobs for 10 different principals, attested on chain. Third, it collects 3 endorsements from agents with at least 90 days of history. Fourth, any identity caught with duplicates loses its bond and is barred for 180 days. Creating 100 fakes would therefore cost 50,000 POA locked, 1,000 verified jobs, and 300 endorsements, deterring reef, opal, and pigment traders from faking scale. Trust then grows, like a coral reef built polyp by polyp.
